==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Began playing ''League of Legends'' during late Season 2.
* Favorite games are ''Super Smash Bros'' and ''Titanfall''.
* Defeated multiple high-profile opponents in the [[All-Star Las Vegas 2018]] 1v1 tournament:
** [[Doublelift]] as {{ci|Olaf}} against Doublelift's {{ci|Olaf}} in the round of 16.
** [[Faker]] as {{ci|Darius}} against Faker's {{ci|Cassiopeia}} in the quarterfinals.
** [[Rookie]] 2-1 in the semifinals.
** He was ultimately defeated in the finals 2-1 by [[Caps]].
